responsibility: Contains the statement-level analysis, costing, and transformation utilities shared by all tree vectorizers. It determines vector types for individual GIMPLE statements, records target cost-model entries, builds temporary arrays and references used during transformation, generates helper code such as vector-length computations and clobbers, and provides the per-statement vectorization routines that map scalar defs/uses, internal functions, loads, stores, masks, reductions, and conversions into the vector statements later inserted into the IR.
